domain: crime, drugs and criminal justice statistics
prediction_question: The lead probed was data.unodc.org, UNODC's data portal of country-year panels for its mandate areas (intentional homicide rate, drug use/production/seizures, trafficking in persons, firearms, corruption, prisons) plus SDG indicators under UNODC custodianship. The plausible task family was a next-year country-level change forecast on one of these panels (e.g. will country X's homicide rate increase next year). The session closed the lead on licence grounds before any task probing: the publisher's own terms prohibit redistribution and derivative works.
prediction_time: Would have been the end of reference year Y (annual country panels) with features lagged appropriately - never reached: licence triage (minutes, first) vetoed the source before any schema or volume work, per the standing order of work.
target_definition: Would have been a binary change target on a country-year indicator (e.g. homicide rate rises in Y+1) - never reached. The label source would have been the Y+1 indicator value itself. Recorded here only so the shape of the closed lead is documented; the verdict is a licence rejection, not a task finding.

sources.name: UNODC Data Portal (data.unodc.org), Office on Drugs and Crime, Vienna
sources.api: Browser application; /api, /about, /help, /documentation, /faq all measured 404 (2026-10-22); no documented anonymous API found. Bulk files are served from /sites/dataportal.unodc.org/files/ (images seen; data download behind the app UI). dataunodc.un.org answers 302 (redirect).
sources.license: No open-licence statement anywhere on the portal (measured: zero matches for creative commons / CC BY / open data / public domain strings on the home and datasearch pages). The portal's own 'Terms and Conditions' link, on both pages probed, points to https://www.unodc.org/unodc/en/legal.html - the UN legal notice that grants 'personal, non-commercial use, without any right to resell or redistribute them or to compile or create derivative works therefrom'.
sources.access: Pages reachable anonymously; no dataset-level licence or citation statement found on any channel probed.

sources.name: UNODC Early Warning Advisory on New Psychoactive Substances - Terms of Use & User Guide (consistent secondary evidence of the publisher's posture)
sources.api: Registered-user service, not an anonymous channel
sources.license: Explicitly: 'Data, whether in aggregated or disaggregated form, cannot be published without prior written authorization by UNODC', 'Disaggregated data cannot be published', and a blanket prohibition on feeding the data to any AI/automated processing service. Consistent with the legal notice: this publisher asserts publication control over its data.
sources.access: Not used; recorded as the publisher's own statement of posture.

license_evidence: Measured 2026-10-22 from https://www.unodc.org/unodc/en/legal.html (fetched, 28,672 B, clause quoted verbatim): '(a) The United Nations ... grants permission to Users to visit the Site and to download and copy the information, documents and materials (collectively, "Materials") from the Site for the User's personal, non-commercial use, without any right to resell or redistribute them or to compile or create derivative works therefrom, subject to ... more specific restrictions that may apply to specific Material within this Site.' A published dataset of derived rows is both a redistribution and a derivative work - squarely prohibited.

Measured 2026-10-22 from https://data.unodc.org/ (44,350 B) and https://data.unodc.org/datasearch (61,728 B): the footer carries 'United Nations Copyright © 2025 UNODC - Data Portal' with links only to https://www.un.org/en/about-us/copyright and https://www.unodc.org/unodc/en/legal.html; grep for licence/open-data strings on both pages: 0 matches. The portal links the restrictive legal notice as its Terms and Conditions, so the notice is the publisher's own instrument for this data, not a general policy page.

UNODC EWA terms (unodc.org/LSS/Page/NPS/Guide, read 2026-10-22): 'Data, whether in aggregated or disaggregated form, cannot be published without prior written authorization by UNODC.' - the publisher states publication control explicitly on its other data services.
split_strategy: Not reached - licence class D stops the order of work at step 1 (licence and terms), before aggregates, schema or split probing. No split capacity, volume or cost was measured, by design.

measurements.licence_triage_2026_10_22: data.unodc.org home HTTP 200 (44,350 B); datasearch HTTP 200 (61,728 B); /api, /about, /help, /documentation, /faq all HTTP 404; dataunodc.un.org HTTP 302. Zero open-licence strings on both fetched pages (grep measured). Only terms instrument linked from the portal: unodc.org/unodc/en/legal.html (class D clause quoted in license_evidence).
measurements.task_probes_deliberately_not_run: Under the standing licence-first order of work (2026-10-21 policy), no schema, volume, base-rate or split probing was spent on this source after the class D instrument was read. The cost of this rejection was six HTTP fetches.

rejection_reason: Licence class D: the publisher's own terms - linked from the data portal as its Terms and Conditions - grant only personal, non-commercial use with no right to redistribute or to create derivative works. Publishing a dataset of derived rows is exactly what is prohibited. Under the standing policy we build only on sources that are already clean, so this is closed, not parked.
next_action: None - closed on licence grounds. Re-open only if UNODC attaches an explicit open licence (e.g. CC BY 3.0 IGO) to the data portal or a named dataset; no permission email, no waiting, per the standing policy.
